reviews.title: All the things I was tracking in this app were deleted.
reviews.text: I had a minimum of half a dozen things tracked in this app, including my husband's sobriety journey, various anniversary reminders & other things. Now I go in the app to add something and everything I was tracking is all gone! No warning, no notice, nothing. That is absolutely NOT acceptable!

reviews.title: Nah
reviews.text: Transferring apps to my new iPhone and i can’t activate my widget without a subscription. get real. devs please don’t post on my review.

reviews.title: *was* a great app…
reviews.text: Loved the original app and its design — unfortunately, widgets now seem to be another paid feature. I found this out the hard way when I upgraded my phone and tried to view all of my counters on my home screen. Such a shame, as visualising my sober streaks easily and at my fingertips (literally) was so important and invaluable. After having this app for years, I will probably have to look for something that is free and offers the same benefits.

reviews.title: Widgets behind pay wall
reviews.text: Having to pay £6 a month for a count down app to unlock widgets is just insane. Every app on app store is a subscription hell hole.
